inputs.name: input_image
inputs.source_color_order: grayscale, BGR, or BGRA as loaded unchanged by OpenCV

outputs.name: enhanced_image
outputs.element_type: matches the uint8 or uint16 input depth
outputs.color_order: grayscale, BGR, or BGRA matching the source mode

preprocessing.normalization: Divide by 65535 when the maximum sample is greater than 256; otherwise divide by 255
preprocessing.channel_handling: Convert grayscale to RGB; separate BGRA alpha; convert BGR to RGB
preprocessing.tensor_conversion: HWC to NCHW, add batch dimension, move to selected torch device
preprocessing.mod_padding: Reflect-pad the right and bottom edges to even dimensions for the native x2 network

postprocessing.tensor_processing: Remove mod/pre padding, clamp to [0,1], convert RGB CHW to BGR HWC
postprocessing.depth_conversion: Round after multiplying by 255 for uint8 or 65535 for uint16
postprocessing.alpha_handling: Upsample the separated alpha channel with Real-ESRGAN by default, then merge it
postprocessing.original_preservation: Output is a derived image; the source image must not be overwritten

benchmarks.adapter_compatibility: PyTorch reference weight; not directly consumable by realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan
benchmarks.blocker: The authorized official artifact is a PyTorch checkpoint. The current separate-process adapter accepts only checksum-bound NCNN param/bin pairs, and no conversion workflow is approved.
